enroll_token.description: a secret — from a file it MUST be a `{{secret:NAME}}` / `{{secret-file:PATH}}` reference; env/flag values may be inline

client_secret.description: a secret — from a file it MUST be a `{{secret:NAME}}` / `{{secret-file:PATH}}` reference; env/flag values may be inline

token.description: a secret — from a file it MUST be a `{{secret:NAME}}` / `{{secret-file:PATH}}` reference; env/flag values may be inline

value.description: a secret — from a file it MUST be a `{{secret:NAME}}` / `{{secret-file:PATH}}` reference; env/flag values may be inline

allow.description: admit only advertised tools matching these globs

exclude.description: never admit advertised tools matching these globs (beats allow)

client_secret.description: a secret — from a file it MUST be a `{{secret:NAME}}` / `{{secret-file:PATH}}` reference; env/flag values may be inline

service.description: reference a services: catalog entry — inherit its connection settings (restating endpoint/auth/headers is refused) and narrow its tool ceiling

labels.description: operator-declared attributes carried into the run, the MCP `_meta` and the audit line

Service.description: a service-catalog entry: connection settings, one shared credential, authoritative trifecta tags (a floor for any matching endpoint), and a tool-surface ceiling consumers can only narrow

allow.description: the CEILING: the widest advertised-tool surface any consumer may get

endpoint.description: the connection URL and the dial-time match base (scheme + authority + path prefix)

exclude.description: never admitted, unioned into every consumer (beats allow)

rate.description: per-instance pacing toward the service (`<burst>/<per>`, e.g. `60/1m`)

tags.description: authoritative — unioned into any consumer whose endpoint matches, referencing or inline, open or closed

min_free.description: shed new work below this much free disk (256MB, 1.5GiB, bytes; 0 disables); warn at twice it

path.description: the state root; default $AGENTD_STATE_DIR, else $XDG_STATE_HOME/agentd/state, else $HOME/.local/state/agentd/state, else the OS temp dir

SubagentTemplate.description: an operator-declared subagent definition: `instruction` is a full instruction document — no config-defining directives = the flat worker; machinery (:::workflow/:::mcp/:::stream/:::config/:::tools) = an instance-tier child

durable.description: false = memory-only record (an instance child runs on a memory store; no restore-respawn); absent = the store.durability.work default

instruction.description: the definition; {{params.X}} holes fold in at spawn as data, never re-parsed for directives

limits.description: flat tier: the per-spawn limits object; instance tier: OS caps only (memory, cpu)

mirror_streams.description: child streams mirrored into the parent's same-named streams (declared on both sides; needs a parent A2A listener)

mode.description: instance tier supports detached only (phase A)

params.description: the ONLY holes the model may fill, schema-validated at spawn

result.description: instance mode: sync — resolve the spawn when the child's named workflow first completes, returning its output (needs a parent A2A listener)

servers.description: flat tier: narrowing server grants from the parent's set

singleton.description: one live child; its A2A peer alias is the template name

ttl.description: instance tier: retire after this long (graceful drain)

until.description: instance tier: a signal name (templated over params) whose delivery in the child retires it

args.description: a JSON template or `CEL: …` producing the MCP tool arguments from `args`/`ctx`

result.description: a JSON pointer / template / `CEL: …` mapping the CallToolResult to the internal output schema

bearer.description: a secret — from a file it MUST be a `{{secret:NAME}}` / `{{secret-file:PATH}}` reference; env/flag values may be inline

equals.description: a secret — from a file it MUST be a `{{secret:NAME}}` / `{{secret-file:PATH}}` reference; env/flag values may be inline

header.description: the header carrying the signature (default X-Signature)

prefix.description: a prefix stripped before the constant-time compare, e.g. sha256=

secret.description: a secret — from a file it MUST be a `{{secret:NAME}}` / `{{secret-file:PATH}}` reference; env/flag values may be inline

WorkflowRef.description: a {name, file|uri|url} reference, a {dir, glob} directory, or an inline workflow definition

allow_private.description: permit `url` to resolve to a private/loopback address

scope.description: what max_runs counts: every run of this workflow (default), or every run about the same `key` — the difference between a queue and a per-entity lock

dir.description: load every matching file in a directory

durable.description: false = runs are memory-only (no checkpoints, gone after a restart) — the fast path for recomputable work; absent = the store.durability.work default (durable)

headers.description: headers for `url` — credential values must be {{secret:…}} references

key.description: the logical thing a run is ABOUT, rendered from the trigger payload (e.g. "{{payload.account_id}}"); required by concurrency.scope: key

priority.description: contention weight: `low` sheds one pressure level earlier and is scheduled last; a tiebreak under scarcity, not a reservation

reducer.description: how concurrent writes to this key combine; declaring it makes concurrency a policy rather than a race

schema.description: a JSON Schema every write to this key must satisfy

tool.description: register this workflow as a first-class tool — a callable procedure with retry, breaker, idempotency and a human gate INSIDE one apparent call. Startup config only; tags are DERIVED from what the steps reach.

mode.description: sync parks the caller on the run and returns its output; async returns a handle

name.description: the tool name callers see; may not shadow an internal contract

unload.description: what happens to LIVE runs when this definition is retired (removed, replaced or deleted)

timeout.description: how long a drain may take

uri.description: an MCP resource (mcp://<server>/<uri>, or one a connected server serves)

url.description: fetched over HTTP(S) at startup; fail-closed if unreachable

description: agentd configuration document (YAML or JSON; several files merge in order; every path is also AGENTD_<PATH> and --<path>)

bearer.description: a secret — from a file it MUST be a `{{secret:NAME}}` / `{{secret-file:PATH}}` reference; env/flag values may be inline

push.description: push notifications: a caller registers a webhook and agentd POSTs its task's updates there. Default-OFF — the URL comes from a peer, so making the request at all is the operator's decision.

allow_private.description: permit webhook targets on private / loopback addresses (a separate and larger decision — a peer could otherwise reach agentd's own surfaces or a cloud metadata endpoint)

enabled.description: accept CreateTaskPushNotificationConfig and deliver on transitions

approval.description: whether a gate asks a person (ask), lets an LLM judge decide (auto), or takes the ask's recommendation (accept); runtime-settable via config.set

ask_human_fallback.description: what ask_human does with no human channel (and, for auto, on an unanswered gate timeout): wait (park until timeout), fail (default), or auto (an LLM judge answers on the operator's behalf, marked as auto)

instruction.description: static text, or a single-token URI a configured MCP server serves (read + subscribed)

name.description: instance identity (falls back to the downward-API instance, then the hostname)

prompt.description: a one-shot task (--prompt): with no workflows configured the generated run executes this, while `instruction` stays the standing policy (the run's system prompt)

model_window.description: the model's context window in tokens (overrides the value inferred from intelligence.model)

model.description: summarize on a cheaper model than the instance's

prompt.description: override the summarizer guidance; the JSON schema it must satisfy is fixed

template.description: the system-prompt template; unset = the built-in default, printed by `agentd --context-template`

templates.description: named alternates a node selects with context: {template: <name>}

condition.description: a cheap CEL predicate over durable state, evaluated first

statement.description: the goal in natural language (the LLM judge reads it)

identity.description: who work is done ON BEHALF OF — including work nobody typed

autonomous_as.description: the actor a schedule/webhook/stream firing is attributed to (default `system`); without it the attribution chain is dropped at its first hop

default.description: the tier used when nothing names one

dialect.description: wire dialect; bedrock = native Amazon Bedrock Converse (pair with auth.kind=aws)

endpoints.description: ordered endpoint list (failover); one comma-separated string is accepted

model.description: the default model — a declared `models:` tier name, or a literal model string

fallback.description: the tier to degrade to — a ladder that walks down instead of failing

model.description: the wire model name sent to the provider

service.description: a `services:` entry of kind: intelligence supplying endpoint, auth and tags

window.description: this model's context window, so compaction stops guessing from the model NAME

models.description: named model tiers: cost/quality tiering inside one workflow without forking a process. A tier points AT a `services:` entry and may only narrow — it inherits that service's trifecta tags and can never declare its own floor.

preflight_model.description: the tier preflight runs on — a recurring fixed cost that does not need the answering model

token.description: a secret — from a file it MUST be a `{{secret:NAME}}` / `{{secret-file:PATH}}` reference; env/flag values may be inline

interface.description: The display-client (TUI/web-UI) surface, served on the A2A listener. Default-OFF.

debug.description: expose extra debug information (transcripts, run step detail, the log ring, audit feed events); runtime-togglable via the config.set op

display.description: what clients render in their chrome — ordered item lists for the top (header) and bottom (status bar) edges; unknown items are skipped

origins.description: extra allowed browser origins (scheme://host[:port]) for a hosted web UI; loopback origins never need listing

pairing.description: pairing-code login: a rotating 6-digit code (shown to operators) a client exchanges for a session token — the low-friction alternative to copying a bearer

role.description: the role a paired session gets (operator or user; default operator)

exit_code_map.description: remap the policy exit codes (3/7 only): {"3": N, "7": N}

until_signal.description: delivery of this signal begins graceful shutdown — the retirement trigger a parent composes into an instance-tier child

max_message_depth.description: how many chained `message` deliveries may run before one is refused (default 8) — the loop guard on message → turn → run → message

fan_out.description: max concurrent lanes a foreach/batch body may use; a definition asking for more is refused at load

stream.description: the declared stream `sink: [stream]` appends to — the supported path off the box, and the only sink a workflow can consume

include.description: event families taken in full (the segment before the first dot); an unknown family is a startup error

queue.description: how many events may queue between ticks before the tap drops and counts (default 512)

sampled.description: event families taken at 1-in-16 — for high-rate families that arrive in storms

stream.description: declared stream the selected events land on

egress.description: closed = an outbound MCP dial whose URL matches no services: catalog entry is refused; default open

exec.description: The guarded local command runner (default-OFF; needs --features exec).

policies.description: ordered verdicts on a tool call; first match wins, no match is allow

action.description: shadow refuses and says the call was held; it never fabricates a result

args.description: CEL over `args`, `tool` and `caller` — the only place an ARGUMENT can be judged, since grants are name patterns

principal.description: principal-id glob, for calls carrying one

tags.description: every listed trifecta tag must be present on the tool

tool.description: tool-name glob; absent matches every tool

question.description: the question put to a person for `ask`; {{tool}}, {{caller}} and {{args}} are substituted

immutable.description: refuse workflow.create/update/delete at runtime — definitions become read-only for the model, subagents and operators alike; loading from config/file/url/dir is unaffected

services.description: the service catalog: the named external services this deployment may use; mcp.servers entries reference entries via `service:` and may only narrow them

dir.description: a local folder of skill files (frontmatter + body, or <name>/SKILL.md); `skills/` beside the config is adopted when this is unset

work.description: default durability CLASS for runs + subagent records: ephemeral = nothing persists unless a workflow/spawn says durable: true (the fast path); default durable

keep_last.description: keep at most this many terminal runs

subagents.description: subagent templates + spawn policy: operator-declared definitions the model may instantiate, filling declared params only

allow_freeform.description: false = templates are the ONLY spawn path (freeform flat-tier instruction spawns are refused); default true

defaults.description: applied to every spawn unless overridden at the template or call site

durable.description: default durability class for spawns (false = memory-only records)

vars.description: operator-defined constants; reference anywhere (and in workflows) as {{config.NAME}} — dotted paths reach nested values, unresolved references refuse startup

listen.description: https://host:port (loopback http:// for dev) — the inbound webhook surface

workflows.description: inline workflow definitions or {name, file|uri} references
